title: Serialization by Header and Action Groups
statement: For every machine $M$ in code normal form, its canonical serialization is its header followed by the concatenation, in increasing state order, of the serialized transition records of that state's nine actions, ordered with the input read varying slowest and the work read varying fastest.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a machine in code normal form
replaced:
The canonical serialization of a coded machine $M$ equals its header
followed by the concatenation, over every state of $M$ in increasing order,
of the concatenated serialized transition records of that state's
nine-action list (its actions on all read pairs, in the fixed input-major
serialization order).
